messages:
deploy-bot: :warning: Release v2026.04.02 -> prod PAUSED by preflight: env parity failure for `CACHE_URL`. staging emits JSON object, prod expects plain URL string. see preflight run: https://ci.internal/runs/10077

marta: What's the exact diff?

ci-bot: snippet:
```
staging: CACHE_URL={"url":"redis://cache.stg:6379","tls":true}
prod: CACHE_URL=redis://cache.prod:6379?ssl=true
```

diego: This traces to the structured-secret rollout for stateful services. Cache client still expects a simple DSN env. Canary crashed during init when it got JSON.

marta: Change window ends in 2h. Hotpatch options?

diego: 1) rollback to v2026.03.31 2) add init container to flatten JSON -> CACHE_URL_STR 3) bump client lib (longer).

ops-oncall: Security: any hotpatch must not log secrets and must emit an audit event for any paramstore writes.

marta: I'll prepare a tiny init-normalizer that inspects CACHE_URL and sets CACHE_URL_STR env. Low blast radius for canary.

diego: I'll create a CACHE_URL_STR alias in paramstore pointing to the DSN for affected services. ETA 20m.

ci-bot: note: update integration tests to prefer CACHE_URL_STR if present.

marta: Canary (10%) up with init-normalizer. Running 15m smoke.

diego: Alias created and audit logged. Original JSON left intact.

marta: Canary smoke passed: no cache init errors, metrics stable.

ops-oncall: Infra review green. Proceed limited rollout with monitoring window and rollback plan ready.

marta: Update release notes: "paused for cache secret schema drift; temporary alias CACHE_URL_STR created; follow-up: standardize secret schema and remove alias." Confluence link appended.

deploy-bot: Release v2026.04.02 status: PAUSED -> CANARY (init-normalizer) -> LIMITED_ROLLOUT pending. Assigned: diego (alias/backfill), marta (canary/hotpatch), ops-oncall (monitor). Action items logged.
